validations.name: physical_host_repository_quality_suite
validations.evidence: Configuration stops before build because XOAS pins Python 3.12.3 and the physical host exposes Python 3.14.4. A direct policy diagnostic also found that host ShellCheck 0.11 reports SC2329 where the pinned development lane is green. These remain explicit qualification-tool deployment gaps and do not qualify product behavior.
